title: If a master enters into an agreement
text:
23.

If a master enters into an agreement
with any seaman for a scale of
provisions less than the scale fixed
under clause (g) of sub-section (2) of
section 101.

98 (2), 99 Fine which may extend
to one hundred rupees
for every seaman in
respect of whom the
offence is committed.

100 Fine which may extend
to one hundred rupees
for every seaman in
respect of whom the
offence is committed.

101(2)(g) Fine which may extend
to two hundred rupees.
